crossRefs.note: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great…
I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for…
The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

translations.web: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.
translations.bsb: So I prophesied as He had commanded me, and the breath entered them, and they came to life and stood on their feet—a vast army.
translations.kjv: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
translations.asv: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
